title: Stepper step-level block for guarantor is E2E-only — no automated test wires required-cohort render through the stepper
evidence:
d. STEP-LEVEL BLOCK: click [data-testid="step-continue-guarantor"]
        with the fields empty — the stepper must NOT advance (eval the
        guarantor section is still the visible step) and its gating
        message shows inside the section. This is the bug's core: the
        requirement holds HERE, not at final submit.
detail: Spec AC #1 requires the stepper block empty guarantor fields AT THE STEP. SSR preconditions (fields expanded + required:True) are unit-pinned in guarantor_section_test and generic gating in form_stepper.test.js, but no automated test asserts the guarantor-step integration; only the manual E2E scenario does.
recommended_fix: Add a form_stepper.test.js case feeding a required-cohort fixture (synthetic _guarantor_fields_open=on + empty guarantor inputs) and assert findInvalidControls returns the guarantor fields so Continue is held.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
evidence:
- Given any required cohort, when the applicant reaches the Guarantor step, then the requirement is declared (notice + fields expanded + no checkbox gate + nothing pre-ticked) and the stepper blocks empty fields AT THE STEP.
- Given any required cohort with filled guarantor fields and no checkbox posted, when submitted, then it validates, persists has_guarantor=true with fields, and writes the attestation record.
- Given an optional cohort, when the box is unticked (even after an earlier check or an unrelated error re-render), then the box never self-marks and the submit is clean.
detail: P0 100%: rule truth table, force_required, persistence alignment, consent attestation all unit+integration pinned. P1 ~90%: cohort SSR render, point-of-selection notes, copy doctrine, optional round-trip unit-pinned. Overall >80%. Only gap is the E2E-only stepper block (see prior note). Gate: PASS.
recommended_fix: To raise to a hard PASS+ add the guarantor-step stepper integration test noted above; otherwise coverage is adequate for merge.
